name: Fujimura Shizu
source:
A new student who is bashful in front of strangers. Her parents left her and she seldom showed her feelings when Wataru met her at first; Saeri stood for her and she began to live on the Tsugumi dorm, and she gradually shows her feeling. She is quiet and small, but she is a good athlete.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kono_Aozora_ni_Yakusoku_wo#Character]Wikipedia[/url]]
